translation: Took place in posad Serock, 13[?] May 1890 [no hour written]. Appeared personally Berek Koltun, messenger[?], 65, and Szapsia[?] Rozental, feldsher[?], 40, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 8 PM in posad Serock died a child of female sex named Chana Ruchla Finkielsztejn, daughter of Josek and [unclear: Bita/Gita] Czyta nee Piekarz, aged nine months. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by one witness.
